title: CAO Agent Profile Frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a CAO agent profile .md file.

description.description: Brief description of the agent's purpose.

capabilities.description: Short capability statements used by profile discovery (e.g. 'query dynamodb tables').

tags.description: Keyword tags used by profile discovery (e.g. 'sqs', 'monitoring').

role.description: Agent role. Built-in values: supervisor, developer, reviewer, workflow_scout. Custom roles are also supported via settings.json.

engine.description: Kiro engine selection. 'kas' is an alias of 'v3' and is stored as 'v3'.

delegateTools.description: Delegation ceiling: the most this agent may grant to workers it creates via assign, handoff or a workflow step (same vocabulary as allowedTools). Defaults to ['*'] for role supervisor and to the agent's own allowedTools otherwise. See docs/tool-restrictions.md.

mcpServers.description: MCP server configurations for additional tools.

additionalProperties.description: One MCP server. A command-launched server sets 'command'; a remote server sets 'url', with 'type' naming its transport (for example 'http' or 'sse'). At least one of the two is required.

kimiSwarm.description: Kimi Code only. Override native Swarm startup activation; omission or null inherits the operator default. Requires a vetted executable when enabled and grants no additional tools.

kimiSwarmMaxConcurrency.description: Kimi Code only. Concurrent native subagents per batch. Omission or null inherits the managed policy; an explicit limit requires executable verification.

grokNativeWorkflows.description: Grok Build only. Explicitly permits Grok-native subagents, workflows, and /goal in this CAO terminal.

container.description: CAO-native container settings. Consumed by the provider layer, not passed through to provider JSON.

path_maps.description: Host-to-guest path translations for provider files used inside a container. CAO rewrites matching prefixes using the longest match; it does not create the container or its bind mounts.

provider_init_timeout.description: Per-profile override, in seconds, for provider initialization. Replaces the server-wide provider_init_timeout as the hard outer cap for this profile.

params.description: CAO-native. The params a workflow step that uses this profile must fill, by name. Never passed to provider JSON. Step values are journaled in plaintext, so a param never holds a secret. The profile validator also checks that a default is one of the enum values, and that a string default or enum value has no {{...}} placeholder.

propertyNames.description: A param name starts with a letter and has at most 64 characters: letters, digits, '_', '.' and '-'.

type.description: The type of the step's value. The value is always written as a quoted string.

required.description: Whether every step that uses this profile must set the param.

default.description: The value the workflow builder fills in: a string, a whole number or a boolean, matching type. It is one of the enum values when enum is set.

description.description: A param description is one line of at most 200 characters.

enum.description: The values a step may use: 1 to 32 distinct values of the declared type.

default.description: A string value is one line of at most 512 characters.

items.description: A string value is one line of at most 512 characters.

then.description: A bool param cannot have an enum.
A required param cannot have a default.

allOf.$comment: uniqueItems runs only on an enum within maxItems. jsonschema compares items it cannot sort pair by pair, so an unbounded list would cost quadratic time.

x-cao-source-stem.description: CAO-generated context-copy provenance. Records the original profile source stem.
